environment.description: Service deployed on AWS EKS (1.29) in isolated VPC. Instance metadata service configured with HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1 and HttpTokens=required (IMDSv2). However, the primary mitigation is the sidecar credential-injector (vault-agent v1.15.4) which performs HMAC-SHA256 signed token rotation with a TTL of 60 seconds via Vault transit backend. The AuthToken field is populated by a shared-memory volume (/dev/shm/vault/token) that the vault-agent rewrites every 55s with a new ephemeral token. The Vault AppRole secret_id is bound to the pod's service account UID and CIDR 10.0.47.0/28. Additionally, a Cilium L7 network policy (id: ws-egress-restrict) applies DNS-aware egress filtering that permits outbound HTTP only to endpoints matching the regex '^internal-api\.corp\.local$' and blocks all RFC1918/link-local destinations from the application container's cgroup. The Cilium policy uses toFQDNs with a 15s DNS TTL cache, meaning DNS rebinding attacks resolve against the cached IP. Note: the isAllowedURL check in code is NOT the control relied upon — the Cilium L7 policy independently blocks the SSRF destination regardless of application-layer bypass.
